entities.name: Guido Maria Conforti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Guido Maria Conforti was an Italian Roman Catholic archbishop who founded the Xaverian Missionaries (S.X.) on 3 December 1895. He was known to make frequent visits to his parishes and worked to support the religious education and religious involvement among the youth.
